dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: Hey! Where did you come from?

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: No commoners are allowed in the military zone! Leave the area now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: Can't you see that from my gear? I'm a soldier. I'm here on a special mission.

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: Heh, an outlander like you should watch yourself. Don't cause any trouble, or I'll see you brought to justice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, see you...

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: Scram!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What sort of mission are you on?

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: What kind of mission, you ask... What kind of mission do you think it would be, in a place like this?!

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: Of course it's... uh, to eradicate evil... and slay all the rebel remnants!

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's all you need to know! You wouldn't understand even if I told you more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this a solo mission?

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: Can't you see that I have a follower right here?

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: Well, not that an elite such as myself needs that many people to complete my mission.

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: Be they rebels or evil lords, I can take care of them with one slash. I don't need others to help me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That seems suspicious. I'm going to report you.

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: Hey! W—W—Wait a minute. What are you doing? Let's talk this out nicely...

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: I'm not bothering anyone else, and I'm not up to no good. Just let me be already!

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: I'm just a samurai on patrol, that's all. Let's just go our separate ways, please.

dialogues.speaker: Terada
dialogues.text: If you keep messing with me like this, outlander, *I'll* report *you* to my superiors! You'd better watch out, because they're gonna come for you!
